name: Erem
description: A kor warrior fighting beside Tazri who is dragged into a seedpod and transformed.

timeline.summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
timeline.quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The kor tell Nahiri of the titans' rise and that some believe they are their old gods.
timeline.quote: three enormous monstrosities rose out of the Teeth of Akoum.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri commands Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians from the Invasion Tree's branches.
timeline.quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Erem is speared, dragged into a seedpod and transformed, laughing mechanically, as Tazri fails to save him.
timeline.quote: two invaders drag him into the nearest seedpod and seal him within.
